title: Design System: St Marys Village Dry Cleaners

display.purpose: Hero h1 only; carries the system's one gradient-text word ("Best").

title.purpose: Component headings: bento-card h3, why-card h3, process-step h3, accordion trigger.

label.purpose: Uppercase small labels: bento-tag, contact-label, footer headers, brand-sub.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for bento/why/contact/gallery cards and the scrolled header.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Hover elevation for bento/gallery cards; resting elevation for the reviews card and header-call pill.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: The floating trust-card and the contact map frame; bento-card hover.

shadows.name: shadow-dark
shadows.purpose: The fixed call affordance and the lightbox image — elements that must float over any background.

shadows.name: amber-ring-glow
shadows.purpose: Why-card hover state, a box-shadow-built ring plus diffuse amber glow, never a border.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for nearly all transitions.

motion.name: reveal-on-scroll
motion.purpose: Section content fade/rise on first scroll into view.

motion.name: shimmer-sweep
motion.value: translateX(-130% -> 130%) over 0.75s, gradient: linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0.55) 48%, transparent 66%)

motion.name: pulse-ring
motion.value: scale(1) -> scale(1.18), 2.4s ease-in-out infinite (header icon); fixed-call-pulse: opacity 0.55->0 + scale(1)->1.5, 2.6s ease-out infinite
motion.purpose: Keeps the Call Now affordances alive without being a loud animation; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Amber-gradient filled CTA with a shimmer sweep; used for Call Now / Get in Touch actions.
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5em; padding: 1em 1.9em; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.98rem; min-height: 48px; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E7AE56, #BD7C2C); color: #0B0A08; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -10px rgba(43,31,15,0.18); } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 18px 38px -12px rgba(216,150,64,0.45); } .ds-btn-primary::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1; background: linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 30%, rgba(255,255,255,0.55) 48%, transparent 66%); transform: translateX(-130%); transition: transform 0.75s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::before, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible::before { transform: translateX(130%); } .ds-btn-primary > * { position: relative; z-index: 2; }

components.name: Glass Button
components.description: Translucent blurred-glass CTA for secondary actions over the dark hero.
components.css: .ds-btn-glass { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5em; padding: 1em 1.9em; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.98rem; min-height: 48px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #F6EFE2; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px); transition: background 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-glass:hover, .ds-btn-glass:focus-visible { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.16); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); }

components.name: Bento Card
components.description: Asymmetric-span service card: image-top with zoom-on-hover, optional floating category tag, fade-in CTA row. No border, box-shadow-only elevation.
components.html:
Most Popular

Professional Dry Cleaning

Everyday wear, delicates and formalwear cleaned to a crisp, pressed finish.
components.css: .ds-bento-card { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 24px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px -2px rgba(43,31,15,0.12); transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), box-shadow 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .ds-bento-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 24px 60px -18px rgba(43,31,15,0.28); } .ds-bento-media { position: relative; overflow: hidden; min-height: 180px; } .ds-bento-media img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .ds-bento-card:hover .ds-bento-media img { transform: scale(1.07); } .ds-bento-tag { position: absolute; top: 0.9rem; left: 0.9rem; background: rgba(251,248,242,0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); color: #8F5E22; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 0.4em 0.8em; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-bento-copy { padding: 1.4rem 1.5rem 1.6rem; } .ds-bento-copy h3 { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.22rem; color: #241E17; } .ds-bento-copy p { margin-top: 0.55rem; font-size: 0.93rem; color: #5B5147; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Why Card
components.description: Icon-beside-heading card (not stacked) with an amber ring-glow hover built from box-shadow only, never a border.
components.html:
Genuinely Local

An independently run shop, not a drop-box for a depot across town.
components.css: .ds-why-card { padding: 2rem 1.6rem; background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px -2px rgba(43,31,15,0.12); transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), box-shadow 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .ds-why-card:hover, .ds-why-card:focus-within { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #E7AE56, 0 20px 46px -16px rgba(216,150,64,0.45); } .ds-why-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.9rem; } .ds-why-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(216,150,64,0.18), rgba(216,150,64,0.06)); color: #BD7C2C; } .ds-why-card h3 { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.08rem; color: #241E17; } .ds-why-card p { margin-top: 0.9rem; font-size: 0.92rem; color: #5B5147; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Fixed Call Affordance
components.description: Pill-shaped, bottom-right fixed tel: link with an ambient pulse ring, the only persistent never-relocated UI element.
components.html: Call Now
components.css: .ds-fixed-call { position: fixed; right: 2rem; bottom: 2rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55em; padding: 0.95em 1.4em; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E7AE56, #BD7C2C); color: #0B0A08; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.92rem; min-height: 48px; min-width: 48px; box-shadow: 0 20px 50px -14px rgba(0,0,0,0.55); transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .ds-fixed-call:hover, .ds-fixed-call:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 22px 54px -12px rgba(216,150,64,0.45); transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-fixed-call-pulse { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #E7AE56; animation: ds-call-pulse 2.6s ease-out infinite; z-index: -1; } @keyframes ds-call-pulse { 0% { opacity: 0.55; transform: scale(1); } 100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.5); } }

components.name: Trust Card
components.description: Floating glass card carrying the 5.0-star/TrueLocal social proof, overlapping the hero/services seam. The negative margin lives on the card itself so the following section's background never clips it.
components.html: 5.0from 8 reviews on TrueLocal
components.css: .ds-trust-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.78); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.3); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.3); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.6); border-radius: 24px; box-shadow: 0 24px 60px -18px rgba(43,31,15,0.28); padding: 1.8rem clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; max-width: 980px; margin: clamp(-100px, -9vw, -70px) auto 0; position: relative; } .ds-trust-score { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 2rem; color: #8F5E22; } .ds-trust-text { font-size: 1rem; color: #241E17; }

components.name: Accordion Item
components.description: Borderless FAQ row with a hairline divider, a rotating +/x icon built from CSS pseudo-elements (never a glyph), and a grid-rows expand animation.
components.html: Call or email us, or drop by in person.
components.css: .ds-accordion-item { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(36,30,23,0.12); } .ds-accordion-trigger { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 1.5rem 0.2rem; font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; color: #241E17; min-height: 48px; } .ds-faq-icon { position: relative; width: 22px; height: 22px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-faq-icon::before, .ds-faq-icon::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; background: #BD7C2C; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .ds-faq-icon::before { width: 14px; height: 2px; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); } .ds-faq-icon::after { width: 2px; height: 14px; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); } .ds-accordion-trigger[aria-expanded='true'] .ds-faq-icon::after { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(90deg); opacity: 0; } .ds-accordion-panel { display: grid; grid-template-rows: 0fr; overflow: hidden; transition: grid-template-rows 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1); } .ds-accordion-item.is-open .ds-accordion-panel { grid-template-rows: 1fr; } .ds-accordion-panel > p { overflow: hidden; min-height: 0; color: #5B5147; line-height: 1.65; }

narrative.overview: The shop's own showroom instruments — a steady amber worklight over a dark counter, panes of glass over display cases, cleanly bordered display cards for each garment category — are the interface's own vocabulary. A visitor opens on a cinematic, duotone-treated hero (dark charcoal ground, warm amber key light, deep vignette) under a glassmorphism nav, then the page resolves into a bright warm-ivory register of elevated, rounded cards: an asymmetric bento grid of services, a numeral-driven process timeline, a glowing why-us grid, a masonry gallery with lightbox, and a rich dark footer that closes the arc back to charcoal. This is a premium-local, craft-driven world, not a chain or a laundromat app — but unlike a flat, hairline-only system, depth here is real: glass, blur, gradient, and warm-tinted shadow all carry weight. Confirmed visual rejections carried through finish review: no kicker/eyebrow label above any headline, no card that pairs a border with a box-shadow at rest ("ghost card"), no Unicode star/rating glyphs (SVG only), and no touch target under 48x48px. Gradient fill is reserved for exactly one word in the entire system (the hero's "Best"); it is not a general emphasis device.
keyCharacteristics: A dark-charcoal-to-amber cinematic hero resolving into a bright warm-ivory register below it — a tonal arc, not a flat palette
Sticky glassmorphism nav and a floating glass trust-card are native to this world; glassmorphism is not banned here, it is the showroom's "pane of glass over the display case"
Warm-tinted shadow tokens (--shadow-sm/md/lg/dark) do real elevation work — never neutral gray
A genuinely asymmetric bento-grid services section (xl/tall/wide/standard spans), not uniform icon tiles
Exactly one sanctioned gradient-text use (hero's "Best"); everywhere else type is solid-color

rules.name: The One Gradient Rule
rules.body: A warm amber gradient text-fill is used in exactly one place in the whole system — the word "Best" in the hero h1. It is a brief-sanctioned emphasis device, not a general pattern; no other heading or word takes a gradient fill.

rules.name: The Lit Glass Rule
rules.body: Glassmorphism (translucent fill + backdrop-filter: blur) is native to this world and appears deliberately in three places — the sticky nav, the floating trust-card, and the glass hero CTA — standing in for "panes of glass over the display case." It is not decoration to scatter onto arbitrary surfaces; it marks a surface that floats over or compresses against other content.

rules.name: The Serif-Weight Rule
rules.body: Every Playfair Display use in the system is weight 700, never italic and never a lighter weight; the serif carries authority through weight, not style variation.

rules.name: The Shadow-Only Elevation Rule
rules.body: A card declares elevation via box-shadow alone at rest and on hover. No card pairs a border with a box-shadow for the same edge; where a ring effect is wanted (why-card hover), it is built as a box-shadow spread, never an actual border property. Glass surfaces (nav, trust-card) are the one exception, since their border is doing material-edge work for the glass itself, not card elevation.

dos: Do reserve the amber gradient text-fill for the hero's "Best" and nowhere else (The One Gradient Rule).
Do elevate cards with box-shadow alone, never pairing a card border with a card shadow; build ring/glow hover effects as a box-shadow spread, not a border (The Shadow-Only Elevation Rule).
Do keep glassmorphism to the three surfaces that are meant to float or compress over other content (nav, trust-card, hero glass CTA) — not decoration on arbitrary panels.
Do author every icon and rating glyph as inline SVG, never a Unicode symbol or icon font.
Do keep every interactive control (buttons, copy buttons, nav toggle, fixed call) at a 48x48px minimum touch target.
Do put the floating-overlap offset on the floating element itself (e.g. the trust-card), never on its wrapper, so the following section's background can never clip it.
Do reserve the outlined/muted serif numeral treatment for the Process section's real 01-04 sequence; do not add decorative numbering elsewhere.
donts: Don't invent review content, star counts, pricing, or years-in-business figures in any new copy; Reviews shows only the sourced TrueLocal aggregate, linked out.
Don't add a hard-offset/neobrutalist drop shadow anywhere; all shadows in this system are soft, warm-tinted, and diffuse.
Don't apply the bento asymmetric-span treatment to a grid where the content isn't genuinely unequal in weight; uniform content gets a uniform grid (why-us, contact-list).
